description:
CIAM Secuirty Developer position offers a hands-on opportunity to join Manulife’s Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) team, supporting critical digital security initiatives. The role directly addresses a skills gap in IBM Verify expertise, contributing to the mission of delivering secure authentication and access for millions of customers. You’ll help scale and strengthen hybrid identity solutions across on-prem and Azure cloud environments, working alongside experienced engineers. This position offers visibility, impact, and the chance to deepen your technical skills in a niche, high-demand area.
 Position Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and support CIAM solutions using IBM Verify (formerly ISAM) in hybrid (on-prem + cloud) environments
 Implement and maintain authentication, federation, and access management capabilities
 Deploy and optimize identity solutions in Microsoft Azure cloud
 Troubleshoot, resolve incidents, and enhance CIAM platform performance
 Collaborate with platform engineers and security teams to ensure compliance and scalability
 Required Qualifications 
 5–7 years of experience in IAM / CIAM or security engineering roles
 Quantified hands-on experience with IBM Verify (formerly ISAM) in hybrid deployments
 Experience supporting identity solutions in Azure cloud environments
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred)
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with large-scale CIAM platforms
 Knowledge of multi-factor authentication (MFA) solutions
 Understanding of hybrid identity architecture patterns
 Experience in financial services or regulated environments
 Exposure to non-containerized deployment models
 When you join our team: 
 We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
 We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
 As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
 
 If you are applying to this role in Massachusetts, please note the salary range is $90,160.00 - $167,440.00 USD. Additionally, employees also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn incentive compensation tied to business and individual performance. 
 
 The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.
